sources: docs/program/pipeline-diagram/parts/*.md (which file stands for which item)
directory listings of research-tree/, tools/, library/

pipelines.title: Problem lookup
pipelines.line: Search the stored problems before spending tokens on solving one.

pipelines.title: Reasoning cache
pipelines.line: A cheaper model reuses solutions that a stronger model produced.

pipelines.title: Code queries
pipelines.line: An agent sends a query and gets a few hundred tokens back instead of whole files.

pipelines.title: Graph model training
pipelines.line: Learn from past commits which files are related; runs on the GPU.

pipelines.title: Code map
pipelines.line: Scripts turn the repository into a graph of facts; no model is used.

pipelines.title: Problem records
pipelines.line: The session that solves a hard problem records it, with a check that proves the cause.

pipelines.title: Standing notes
pipelines.line: Text loaded into every session at start.

pipelines.title: Library
pipelines.line: The project's record of decisions, measurements and mistakes.

pipelines.title: Plan
pipelines.line: Split a request into units of work and order them.

pipelines.title: Admit
pipelines.line: Decide which units start now, and on which model.

pipelines.title: Work
pipelines.line: Units run as a tree of sessions, one purpose per session.

pipelines.title: Check
pipelines.line: Test and review every change before it is merged.

pipelines.title: Land
pipelines.line: Merge checked changes one at a time, in order.

pipelines.title: Learn
pipelines.line: Record the measurements and findings of the task.

pipelines.title: Guards
pipelines.line: Scripts that check a step before it runs and can refuse it.

pipelines.title: Limits
pipelines.line: The number of units that run at once is set by the tightest limit.

pipelines.title: Context
pipelines.line: Keep each session's context window small, since every call re-reads all of it.

pipelines.title: Recovery
pipelines.line: Work is kept and resumed when a session or the machine fails.

pipelines.title: Measurement and research
pipelines.line: Measurements and research are used to revise the harness rules.

links.label: measurements and research return as library records and revised rules

parts.name: Start hook
parts.owner: Start hook: loads the board, also after a compaction
parts.note: Loads the board at session start and after a compaction; the board is injected, so Read calls under-count the board.

parts.name: Tier hook
parts.owner: Tier hook: refuses the wrong model for the kind of job
parts.note: Checks the model against the kind of job at every helper start.

parts.name: Plan gate
parts.owner: Plan gate: refuses a start the plan does not allow
parts.note: Holds the build root to the plan file; only the build root has a plan.

parts.name: Record guard
parts.owner: Record guard: no edits to evidence or journal lines; no design questions to the owner
parts.note: Refuses edits of evidence and journal lines and design questions to the owner.

parts.name: Window ceiling
parts.owner: Fill gauge: a script reads the fill at every step
parts.note: Reads the window fill at every call and refuses past the ceiling. The owner lists the ceiling as designed.

parts.name: Count gate
parts.owner: Step "Concurrency"
parts.note: Refuses a helper start past the width in force. Built; the owner lists concurrency as designed.

parts.name: Fan-out gate
parts.owner: Tree caps: 3 children, 3 levels
parts.note: Refuses a helper start with no stated token limit and its measured basis. Built; the owner lists tree caps as designed.

parts.name: Owner report
parts.owner: Step "Report"
parts.note: Checks that what reaches the owner (closing box, pages) is plain and short.

parts.name: Journal watch
parts.owner: Step "Journal"
parts.note: After a shell call, checks the journal files are in the state the journal tool left them.

parts.name: Commit check
parts.owner: Commit check: also catches writes made through the shell
parts.note: Runs through tools/git-hooks/pre-commit on every git commit in this clone. A shell call running git commit (with or without -c options before it) counts as a read; reading or naming the file counts too. Not seen: a commit made by another program.

parts.name: Journal tool
parts.owner: Correction: a new record replaces a wrong one; the top session decides
parts.note: The only writer of journal records; a write shows as a shell call that names it.

parts.name: Settings
parts.owner: Least privilege: each role gets only its tools and folders
parts.note: Switches skills off and denies the archived agents; also wires the hooks.

parts.name: Hook tests
parts.owner: Self-test and canary: a planted violation must be caught
parts.note: Tests and a self-test of the hooks.

parts.name: Hooks readme
parts.owner: Step "Foundations"
parts.note: Says which hooks exist and how helper definitions relate to the tier hook.

parts.name: Hook logs
parts.owner: Step "After the run"
parts.note: One log per hook; the monitor reads them. A part for the owner's "transcript audit" only in the sense that it holds what the hooks saw.

parts.name: Look-up script
parts.owner: Step "Lookup"
parts.note: Looks a record up by id or keyword; a shell call that names it.

parts.name: The lane
parts.owner: The lane: a queue with a few slots, low priority, a time limit
parts.note: Queues heavy commands; seen only when a session names it.

parts.name: Role guard
parts.owner: Least privilege: each role gets only its tools and folders
parts.note: Per-role tool and folder limits of the research tree (built, never run on a real tree).

parts.name: Role settings
parts.owner: Least privilege: each role gets only its tools and folders
parts.note: The tool and folder limits and briefs of each role of the research tree.

parts.name: Trusted checker
parts.owner: Trusted checker: only a small script promotes a claim to a fact
parts.note: The small script that promotes a claim to a fact.

parts.name: Tree self-test
parts.owner: Self-test and canary: a planted violation must be caught
parts.note: Planted violations must be caught; the tests of the research tree scripts.

parts.name: Ready queue
parts.owner: Ready queue: units whose dependencies are all done
parts.note: Admits units whose dependencies are done.

parts.name: Watcher
parts.owner: Watcher: reads, decides, exits
parts.note: Stall, hang and loop watch; built and tested, never run on a real tree.

parts.name: Commit record
parts.owner: Commit record: a result exists once its record is written; the first record wins
parts.note: Writes the commit record of a unit; the first record wins.

parts.name: Hand-over script
parts.owner: Hand over through files, not through a session's memory
parts.note: Hands work over through files; also the cost and timing scripts.

parts.name: Token tally
parts.owner: Token tally: every transcript counted, per session and per unit
parts.note: Counts the tokens of every transcript, per session and unit.

parts.name: Machine recorder
parts.owner: Machine recorder: memory, processor, the test queue
parts.note: Records memory, processor and the test queue.

parts.name: CLAUDE.md
parts.owner: Step "Instruction file"
parts.note: Loaded by the app at start, so Read calls under-count it.

parts.name: Board
parts.owner: Step "Board"
parts.note: Injected at start by the start hook, so Read calls under-count it.

parts.name: Library rules
parts.owner: Step "Record"
parts.note: The rules of a record and the glossary.

parts.name: Recall tests
parts.owner: Recall test: a new session answers questions from the library alone
parts.note: The tests that a new session can answer from the library alone.

parts.name: Orchestration
parts.owner: Root session: coordinates only; keeps the task table
parts.note: How a planned multi-session build is run.

parts.name: Tree protocol
parts.owner: Worker session: one unit, in its own copy (a worktree)
parts.note: The design of the session tree and the research programme.

parts.name: Plan
parts.owner: Plan file: role, model, token limit and order, read by the plan gate
parts.note: Read by the plan gate; the gate is the usual reader, a session need not open it.

parts.name: Tier routes
parts.owner: Haiku: locate things, extract into a fixed form
parts.note: Which model for which kind of job; read by the tier hook.

parts.name: Briefs
parts.owner: Brief: one page with scope, file pointers, settled points, open items, done condition
parts.note: One page per unit or helper: scope, file pointers, done condition.

parts.name: State files
parts.owner: Notes file: written before a hand-over, read back after it
parts.note: Written before a hand-over and read back after it.

parts.name: Start here
parts.owner: Hand over through files, not through a session's memory
parts.note: Where the research tree stands, for a fresh session.

parts.name: Enforcement table
parts.owner: Trusted checker: only a small script promotes a claim to a fact
parts.note: Every rule with what enforces it and what it cannot see.

parts.name: Design records
parts.owner: Identify the classical problem and its standard solution first
parts.note: The research tree's designs, rulings and fault analyses.

parts.name: Build documents
parts.owner: Model check: the rules run as a state machine with faults injected
parts.note: Design documents of the build rounds.

parts.name: Measurements
parts.owner: Re-reads are 96.8 % of all tokens: usage = calls × window size
parts.note: Where tokens go, and what the graph test found.

parts.name: Journal
parts.owner: Step "Journal"
parts.note: Append-only records; written only through the journal tool.

parts.name: Evidence
parts.owner: Seven measures: throughput, efficiency, token count, token cost, time taken, quality, hallucinations
parts.note: Kept as it is; a session may read it, never edit it.

parts.name: Run folders
parts.owner: Questions fixed before any reading starts
parts.note: A research run lives in its own folder outside every repository.

parts.name: Memory folder
parts.owner: Memory index: one line per lasting note; a note is opened only when needed
parts.note: Loaded at start by the app, so Read calls under-count it.

parts.name: Usage log
parts.owner: Tokens per unit become the next plan's estimate
parts.note: Tokens per unit, the basis of the next plan.

parts.name: Task table
parts.owner: Task table: units, attempts, states
parts.note: Units, attempts and states on disk. Placement inferred from the folder names, not checked against the scripts.

parts.name: Plan steps
parts.owner: Step "Split into units"
parts.note: The session's own step list; the owner lists splitting as designed.

parts.owner: Worker session: one unit, in its own copy (a worktree)
